# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the time he brought Nell to Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed was an unusual-looking man with an awkward frame and lengthy iron-gray hair reaching down to his hunching shoulders. He had warm brown eyes, a timid expression, and wore a thick, gentle brown beard continuously from the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Obed was extremely shy, timid, taciturn, and uncommunicative, habitually preferring to remain silent while listening quietly to others. Despite his intense bashfulness around women and young girls, he possessed a soft, tender heart and a deep, patient warmth. Once he set his mind on a course of action, he clung to it with an astonishing, quiet stubbornness.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c14 P49](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0049), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004)_

## Traits

- Extremely timid and shy  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c21 P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031)</sub>
- Taciturn and uncommunicative  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019)</sub>
- Quietly stubborn  <sub>[v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024)</sub>

- Fear of women and young girls  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c6 P37](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0037)</sub>

## Abilities

- Predicting the weather  <sub>[v1 c22 P4](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0004)</sub>

## Goals

- Provide Nell Harcourt with a loving home, proper schooling, and happiness  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy lived on his farm, Grey Shutters, in Brierley alongside his sister Thirza. Seeking a young boy from an asylum to help on the farm as he aged, Obed went to the Alder River station to collect him, only to discover a young girl, Nell Harcourt, sent by mistake. Unable to break the news to her, Obed brought her back to Grey Shutters and quietly insisted that she be allowed to stay. Over the years, he developed a deep bond of mutual affection with Nell, spoiling her and taking great pride in her academic successes. Prior to Nell's departure for higher studies, Obed passed away at Grey Shutters following his ongoing heart trouble. Years after his passing, Nell continued to remember him as the first person who gave her affection and understanding, faithfully visiting his grave in the Brierley cemetery.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P16](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0016), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001), [v4 c3 P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_

## Background by volume

- Son of a bashful father who built Grey Shutters far back from the main road  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Suffered from heart trouble in his old age  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>
- Had grown a thick brown beard at the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Purchased a calf that he later gave to Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v2 c1 P16](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0016)</sub>
- Bought Nell a brown gloria dress for her school concert  <sub>[v4 c1 P29](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0029)</sub>
